question: The ratio of the three sides of the triangle are 5 ∶ 13 ∶ 12. What is the largest angle of the triangle ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the sides ratio: 5, 12, and 13.

Recognize the Pythagorean triplet: 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169.

Compare with the square of the largest side: 13² = 169.

Since 5² + 12² = 13², the triangle must be a right-angled triangle.

In any right-angled triangle, the largest angle is always 90 degrees.

**∴ The correct answer is 90 degrees.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Ratio of sides = 5 : 13 : 12

Formula: If a² + b² = c², then the triangle is right-angled and the largest angle is 90 degrees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9f64264c3411c4751a6eb4d38f3ce3e8ac5b6656c0d787c53cec7f666f9de3b.png] 

⇒ Let the sides of the triangle be 5x, 12x, and 13x.

⇒ Square of the longest side = (13x)² = 169x²

⇒ Sum of squares of other two sides = (5x)² + (12x)²

⇒ Sum = 25x² + 144x² = 169x²

⇒ Since (5x)² + (12x)² = (13x)², Pythagoras theorem is satisfied.

⇒ The triangle is a right-angled triangle.

⇒ In a right-angled triangle, the angle opposite the longest side (hypotenuse) is 90 degrees.

**∴ The correct answer is 90 degrees.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), (8, 15, 17), and (9, 40, 41). Any multiple of these ratios also forms a right-angled triangle.

Classification of Triangles by Sides

If a² + b² > c², it is an acute-angled triangle. If a² + b² = c², it is a right-angled triangle. If a² + b² < c², it is an obtuse-angled triangle.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180 degrees. In a right triangle, the other two angles are complementary (sum to 90 degrees).</p
